correctness.rationale: For any integer width ell>=2, any kappa>1 and ambient N>=ell+1, the Gaussian proxy covariance reduces exactly to a 2x2 positive-definite Wishart matrix with independent chi-square diagonal masses. The spectral-projector identity proves weaker-mode majority iff V>kappa^2 U; power iteration converges almost surely because the leading eigenvalue is simple and independent Gaussian initialization is nonorthogonal. Independent gamma ratios yield the exact symmetric Beta CDF. Orthogonal Pythagoras yields the strict reconstruction lower bound, including arbitrary co-range postprocessing. Density single-crossing proves strict width monotonicity. Endpoint Laplace plus Stirling proves the sharp fixed-gap prefactor; independent chi-square CLT and monotone inversion prove the collapsing-gap sketch budget. The 40 exact-rational CDF, 1500 spectral and projection tests, 1235 probability monotonic checks, 11 asymptotic checks, 90000 simulated sketches and 200 direct powers in verify.py all passed. Monte Carlo is not the proof.

originality.rationale: The highly relevant original paper already states the fixed-proxy top-eigenspace limit, and a second 2026 paper derives broad fast-sketch guarantees. This claim is limited to the exact wrong-orientation probability, its unavoidable projection-loss event, and sharp confidence budgets in fixed- and collapsing-gap regimes. Primary full-text comparison, actual semantic record searches, alternative PCA/Wishart phrasing, and published scientific record comparisons did not identify a statement implying this conjunction. Standard Gaussian chi-square/F/Beta identities are acknowledged, not claimed new. Residual risk remains for an old PCA principal-axis misclassification law in an unindexed statistical paper.
residual_risks: An older exact two-dimensional sample principal-component/Wishart orientation theorem may directly imply the beta law under a different name; the database search is not proof of uniqueness.
The limit q→∞ is explicitly known in Chang and Yang and is not claimed original.
Real one-column range sketches are outside the source paper’s multi-column high-probability theorem parameter conditions; no contradiction to its guarantees is asserted.

value.rationale: The exact event is naturally motivated by a known limitation of fixed-proxy sketch powering: infinite iterations identify the proxy dominant direction, which can disagree with the data’s dominant mode. Rather than an arbitrary matrix statistic, it is the probability that power iteration concentrates more strongly on the wrong singular mode; on that event every rank-one reconstruction inherits a strict loss floor. The exact confidence budget has two independent, sharp constants: logarithmic in inverse risk for a fixed spectral gap, but quadratic in the inverse spectral gap for a fixed confidence. The positive-probability deterioration of unpowered sketches quantifies the importance of choosing proxy width rather than increasing power depth. The rank-two model is the smallest natural nontrivial competition between singular directions; numerical checks alone are not treated as mathematical value. Limits to independent real Gaussian, one-column, fixed-proxy, exact arithmetic are explicit.
